1. Start point: the reactor inlet, with stream 3 built from the fresh feeds plus the paper's recycle 12 as a fixed feed (rule B.1). Reason: the reactor is imposed in the base case, so starting there gives every downstream unit the paper's flows; the alternative start (stream 4 as a feed to T-101) is tested only if the reactor step fails.

2. Units in order, each run and balanced before the next: V-101 + P-101 + R-101 (conversion reactor, isothermal 363 K; duty reported) + P-102; T-101 (purity-specified bottoms, vapour distillate); valve + E-101; valve on 5; M-101 with the solvent from the paper's stream 14; T-102; valve; T-103; E-102.

3. Recycle closures (rule B.4): the solvent loop first, when the build reaches E-102 (tear 14; T-102 + T-103 + E-102 + M-101; circulation fixed, make-up equal to the loss); then the reactant loop (tear 12 to V-101), fresh feeds fixed. Broyden first; per-component tear check; tighten from the saved answer.
4. Whole plant: compare against comparisons_declared; rule G on every stream; rule H timing (run.timing) per run, slow runs flagged.
